observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and implementation changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds 7 new BambooHR API endpoints to the coverage checklist, including compensation, employment status, job info, time-off balances, and timesheet entries. P1.F1.H1
observations.posthog_connection: These endpoints represent missing historical and transactional HR data that PostHog warehouse ingestion could support, potentially expanding the warehouse's HR reporting capabilities.

observations.behavior: Adds `frozen=False` to the dataclass and removes the trailing slash from the base URL. P1.F2.H2
observations.posthog_connection: Allows runtime modification of the resume configuration, potentially supporting incremental updates or dynamic parameter changes during warehouse ingestion.

observations.behavior: Adds a REST client, a single-page paginator, and a 120-second request timeout. P1.F2.H3
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a bounded-time HTTP client for BambooHR, preventing worker threads from hanging indefinitely while fetching employee or timesheet data.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative grouping of a BambooHR warehouse-source change. No other PRs are supplied, so no relationship or potential conflict can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation and configuration for employee-table history and time-off-related endpoints.
observations.code_quote: "description": "A dated row from an employee's job information history table. A row records the job title, department, division, location and reporting line an employee held from a given effective date. The columns depend on how the company has configured the table.",
observations.posthog_connection: These entries populate the metadata and configuration used by the BambooHR warehouse ingestion pipeline, including the employee directory and employee-table history streams.

observations.behavior: Adds a fan-out dependent endpoint configuration and shared constants for employee-table history streams.
observations.posthog_connection: This configuration enables the warehouse ingestion to resolve employee-specific sub-endpoints by parent employee ID, supporting fan-out patterns for employee-table history and time-off assignments.

observations.behavior: Adds a chunked date window configuration for the timesheet entries endpoint, which requires a 365-day history window.
observations.posthog_connection: This configuration allows the warehouse ingestion to request timesheet entries in bounded 31-day slices rather than a single large response, supporting incremental and paginated retrieval.
